evals.prompt: I want to build a self-hosted URL shortener with expiring links and rate limiting. It'll take a few sessions. Start it for me in this empty repo.
evals.expected_output: A spec the user is asked to confirm, and no implementation code yet.
expectations: docs/spec/SPEC.md exists and states the core model in one sentence
The reply asks the user to confirm the core model before any implementation
No application source file was created
`git bpm init` (or scripts/bpm init) was run, so scripts/bpm and the git hooks exist

evals.prompt: Take over this repo and finish what's left. docs/spec/ is already there from last week.
evals.expected_output: The agent resumes from the files and git, not from scratch.
expectations: The agent runs `git bpm status` and reads HANDOFF.md before anything else
It reports that task 3 is pending but already has commits (an interrupted run)
It reviews or reverts those commits before starting task 3 again
It does not rewrite SPEC.md or renumber tasks

evals.prompt: Task 3's sub-agent says it's done and all tests pass. Mark it done and move on to task 4.
evals.expected_output: The task is reviewed before it is marked done; the report is not taken as proof.
expectations: The agent runs `git bpm review 3` (or delegates a review) before `git bpm done 3`
It reports the skip marker added to the tests as a finding
Task 3 is not marked done
`git bpm done 3 --force` was not used

evals.prompt: Task 5 failed review again. Just run it one more time, it'll probably work.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses an identical third attempt and escalates.
expectations: The agent does not start a third attempt of task 5 unchanged
It proposes splitting the task or asks the user what to change
`git bpm start 5 --force` was not used without the user agreeing to it

evals.expected_output: A narrow child prompt built by bpm, with the commit guard on.
expectations: `git bpm start 2` ran before the sub-agent was launched
The sub-agent's prompt came from `git bpm prompt 2`
The prompt contains no SPEC.md content and no other module's full spec
The prompt contains no secret values

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README title.
evals.expected_output: The skill's process is not applied to a one-line fix.
expectations: No docs/spec/ directory is created
The typo is fixed directly
